sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: health probe TCP on port 625<instance no.>, interval 5, probeThreshold 2; HA ports; idle timeout 30; 'Enable Floating IP'; 'Don't enable TCP timestamps on Azure VMs that are placed behind Azure Load Balancer. Enabling TCP timestamps causes the health probes to fail. Set parameter net.ipv4.tcp_timestamps to 0'; 'To prevent saptune from changing the manually set net.ipv4.tcp_timestamps value from 0 back to 1, update saptune version to 3.1.1 or higher'; the azure-lb resource answers port 625<instance no.> in a group colocated with the promoted HANA. The load balancer metric DipAvailability (Health Probe Status) is from memory of the Load Balancer documentation (to verify).
